descriptionEn: Cumin, chili flakes, salt. Nothing more is needed.
descriptionZh: 孜然、辣椒碎、盐。不需要更多了。

stepsEn: Pat lamb chops dry. Mix cumin, chili flakes, Sichuan pepper and salt. Rub generously all over the chops. Marinate at room temperature 30 min minimum.
Heat a cast-iron grill pan or outdoor grill until smoking hot.
Brush chops lightly with oil. Grill 3–4 min per side for medium (adjust for thickness). Do not move them once placed — let the crust form.
Rest 5 min. Finish with a final dusting of cumin and chili before serving.
stepsZh: 羊排拍干，将孜然、辣椒碎、花椒和盐混合，大量涂抹在羊排上，室温腌制至少30分钟。
铸铁烤盘或户外烤架烧至冒烟热。
羊排刷少量油，每面烤3-4分钟至五分熟（根据厚度调整），放上后不要移动——等待焦壳形成。
静置5分钟，上桌前再撒一层孜然和辣椒碎。
details.notesEn: The simplicity is the point. Xinjiang lamb needs nothing but heat, cumin and chili. Any further intervention is a mistake. The smoke is essential — do not attempt this on a low flame.
details.notesZh: 简单本身就是意义。新疆羊肉只需要高温、孜然和辣椒。任何多余的干预都是错误。烟熏气不可缺少——不要在小火上做这道菜。
